vocalizations.description: Male song of warbles, whistles and twitters; more elaborate on the Pacific slope (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0).
Harsh 'chur' call (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0). Context is not stated in the source; the program uses this call as its alarm, so 'Contact' is an authored label.

taxonomy.note: GBIF accepted species, Thraupidae, authorship (P.L.Sclater, 1860). iNaturalist taxon 54980 checked 2026-11-01: same name, species rank, active, not extinct.

external.note: iNaturalist id 54980 via Wikidata P3151 and checked at the iNaturalist API. The eBird code is omitted: not verified.

conservation.note: IUCN category least concern via Wikidata P141 (Q211005). The IUCN Red List page itself is not openly licensed and was not used. Wikipedia cites BirdLife International (2021) e.T103817300A138618878.

range.note: Article says the species 'breeds from southern Mexico through Central America to the Chocó of northwestern South America'; it names Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru (far north-western Peru, subspecies ophthalmica). The Central American and Mexican country list is inferred from 'through Central America' and is not itemised in the source.

traits.limb_count.note: Two legs on a passerine bird.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Hop on the ground while foraging; flight is the escape mode. Walking is not documented in the source and is not declared.

traits.flight.note: Article describes flight-related escape and nesting behaviour; powered flight is a class-level trait for passerines.

traits.nest_type.note: Article: 'flimsy cup nest' placed 0.4 to 6 m up in a tree fork.

traits.size_class.note: Derived from mass_kg under the schema's Tiny threshold (< 0.05 kg).

traits.mass_kg.note: Article states 'weighs 11 g (0.39 oz)'. No primary source checked; the mass range is omitted because no range is given.

traits.length_m.note: Article states 10.5 cm (4.1 in) in length, converted to metres.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Derived from one apparent annual adult survival estimate, S = 0.54 (se 0.05), row X=765 of ELEscholer2020_data.csv (Rogers & Meisel 2009; mark-recapture; Heredia Province, Costa Rica; 5-year duration). Equation: mean lifespan under constant annual survival = -1 / ln(S) = -1 / ln(0.54) = 1.62 years, rounded to 1.6. Assumptions: constant survival; a single population; S is apparent survival, which is biased low wherever emigration occurs, so this value is probably a lower bound on true wild lifespan. The CSV has no age-class column; the study's adult scope is taken from the dataset description and not checked in the source paper. Not a maximum or captive value.

traits.diet.note: Authored allocation from the article: 'feeds mainly on grass seeds but also takes other seeds, berries and some insects'. Seed 0.85, fruit 0.05 (berries), invertebrate 0.1 are judgement values. Sums to 1.0. No quantitative diet study was checked.

traits.social.note: Article: 'flocks with other species of seedeaters in pasture, weedy fields and other grassland'. Group size range is judgement.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Judgement: diurnal passerine. The article does not state an activity pattern.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: small passerine escapes by flight. Not stated in the article.

habitat.note: Article: 'lowlands and foothills up to 1,500 m ... semi-open areas such as forest edges, roadsides, low scrub and gardens'. Resource weights, the ground/arboreal split and human-tolerance values are judgement.

seasonal.note: No breeding months are recorded yet. The Wikipedia article gives a clutch of two or three eggs and a 12 to 14 day incubation, with no calendar.

vocalizations.note: Song described in words; no recordings attached.

look.note: Judgement, based on the article's description of the nominal male: black with a white wing speculum and white wing linings. Proportions and poses are authored. Not checked against a reference photograph.

behavior.note: Shared program bt-perching-songbird-v1 selected with food_tag seed and eating by hop. Authored. Breeding-month parameters pending the seasonal evidence.
